findings.title: Materials' 66-point lens gap signals earnings cliff
findings.body: Materials trades at 16.30x forward but 36.21x trailing, a 66-point percentile gap that is the widest in the table. The market is underwriting 122 percent earnings growth, which would be a dramatic reversal from the depressed trailing base.

findings.title: Health Care at all-time forward high despite 45% compression
findings.body: Health Care's forward P/E of 20.21 sits at the 100th percentile of its five-year range, yet the multiple is 45 percent below trailing. That compression implies 81 percent earnings growth, a bet on margin expansion that the market has never priced at this level before.

findings.title: Energy's cheap forward hides rich trailing percentile
findings.body: Energy's forward P/E of 11.39 is at the 36th percentile, but its trailing multiple of 18.54 sits at the 83rd percentile. The 47-point gap is the market pricing in 63 percent earnings growth, a sharp rebound that would need commodity prices to cooperate.
